theorem: If A[I,I]=D+R+E on |I|=r+3, |Dii|>=d, rank(R)<=r, and |E|max<=eps, then s3(A[I,I])>=d-(r+3)eps and the physical-fiber density bound follows.
slab_consequence: If |E|max<=c/rho and r+3 diagonals exceed d, then rho<=((r+3)c+2sqrt(6pi(r+3)))/d.
